name: Halloween Lights
description: adds a decorative string of Jack-o-lantern lights to the site.
project_description:
Features 
 A module that adds a string of pumpkin lights to the top of your website. The Jack-o'-lanterns randomly glow as if lit by a candle.

 Post-Installation 
 Just enable the module and the Halloween Lights display on every non-admin page.

 Similar projects 
 Inspired by the Happy New Year and Merry Christmas! module.

 Halloween Lights is also available for Backdrop CMS .

 The Academy of Model Aeronautics supported development of this module. Back to top
